code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    marks=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==5]
    # The marker attached to the pattern is the one nearest other colored cells.
    def near(p):
        r,c=p
        return sum(1 for rr,row in enumerate(grid) for cc,v in enumerate(row) if v and v!=5 and max(abs(rr-r),abs(cc-c))<=3)
    src=max(marks,key=near)
    dst=min((p for p in marks if p!=src),key=near)
    dr,dc=dst[0]-src[0],dst[1]-src[1]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v and (r,c)!=src and (r,c)!=dst:
                # copy pixels associated with source pattern (all nonzero pixels)
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                if 0<=rr<len(g) and 0<=cc<len(g[0]): g[rr][cc]=v
    return g
'''
